lines.say: Is a banana the perfect pre-workout?
A banana gives you quick carbs, about twenty-five to thirty grams, plus a little potassium. And it's easy on the stomach.
In one study, cyclists who ate bananas performed as well as those who drank sports drinks.
Carbs before training top up your energy, which helps long or hard sessions.
Eat it thirty to sixty minutes before. Add some yogurt or milk if you want protein too.
For a short, easy session, you don't need it. For long, hard ones, it really helps.
Cheap, natural, and it comes in its own wrapper.
